text:
Anita: Need help scheduling final loop for Diego Alvarez (SWE IC3). He's in IST (Bangalore) and can do 70:30pm IST Mon-Wed next week. Wants remote but may consider SF onsite if visa/time allows. Also flagged that he uses a wheelchair and might need larger-font test materials. Can someone own coordination?
Priya: I can coordinate candidate comms and accommodations. Who owns scheduling?
Jordan L: I can run scheduling. Which folks should be on the panel?
Anita: Panel = Jordan + Priya (hiring manager) + Maya K (release eng) + bar raiser (Theo). Two 40m interviews + 30m debrief. Prefer blocks starting 7pm IST to fit PST mornings.
Maya K: Ill check room availability in SF for a potential onsite and flag accessibility details. If remote, I can help with test environment and loaner if needed.
accessibility-bot: Found accessible rooms: SF-2B (ramp + wider table) available Tue 9
m2pm PST. Large-print test materials can be created on request.
Priya: We'll prioritize remote. Request an ASL interpreter if candidate prefers in-person—Anita can confirm with Diego. Also prepare large-print PDF and reduce time pressure on timed coding.
Anita: I asked Diego: he prefers remote but wants the option to come in if we can cover visa/time. He asks for large-print tests and a short 10-min tech-check call before the loop. He also requested timezone-friendly slots only (no <7pm IST).
Jordan L: OK locking remote panel Tue 7pm IST (which is Mon 8:30am PST). That lets Theo and Maya join morning PST. Will create 2x40m + 30m debrief.
interview-bot: Proposed slots sent to candidate via Greenhouse: Tue 19:00 IST / Wed 19:00 IST / Mon 20:00 IST. Candidate selected Tue 19:00 IST. Calendar invites pending accept.
Maya K: I'll set up a dedicated Zoom meeting with interpretation channel and "large font" PDF in the panel docs. Also reserve a test slot 18:50 IST for the 10-min tech-check.
travel-ops: FYI if candidate chooses onsite later, we can provide visa support letter and standard travel booking. Please submit TRVL-req if you want us to start.
Priya: Sending DocuSign NDA + interview packet now. Also attaching large-print PDF of the exercise and accessibility notes for interviewers.
Anita: Please note stipend policy: remote internet stipend of $30 available on request. Put in expense form INF-REIMB-2024.
Jordan L: Sending calendar invites now. Ill include a note to panel: "be mindful of pacing + use rubric."
interview-bot: Calendar invites and Zoom link sent to panel and candidate. Tech-check invite sent 10 minutes prior.
Priya: Checklist: 1) candidate confirmed slot (Anita) 2) Zoom + tech-check (Maya) 3) large-print materials + rubric (Priya) 4) interpreter request queued if onsite (Priya) 5) stipend form and visa support policy linked (Priya/travel-ops).
Maya K: I'll pin large-font exercise in the meeting and test screen-share. If candidate wants a loaner for test, tell them to arrive 20 minutes early at reception.
Anita: Diego confirmed remote Tue 19:00 IST. He accepted calendar invite and will join tech-check at 18:50 IST. He asked to receive the large-print PDF via email.
Priya: Sent large-print PDF and stipend instructions to Diego. Reimbursement link: https://redwood-hr.s3/forms/inf-reimb-2024.pdf
Jordan L: Great. I'll remind panel 24h before and add rubric to the event.
travel-ops: Logged potential visa assistance task TRVL-3921 in case Diego pursues onsite.
Anita: Thanks all, closing the loop. :thumbsup:
